title: Old Fashioned Dutch Plum Tomato Skewers
description: A pungent and flaky nostalgic Dutch dish featuring plum tomatoes, this recipe is perfect for a summer evening, it is also onion and garlic free.
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to medium high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped parsley and basil to the bowl and mix well.
Cut the plum tomatoes in half and add them to the bowl, toss to coat with the oil mixture.
Thread the tomatoes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each tomato.
Place the skewers on the robata grill and cook for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.
After 10 minutes, sprinkle the feta cheese over the tomatoes and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the grill and squeeze the lemon juice over the top.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley and basil if desired.
